services.name: PRIVATE Sunset Sailing Cruise
services.desc: Rates Private Sunset Cruise: Starting at $995 for up to 8 guests. $99 for each additional guest. 24 guest maximum. About Have our beautiful sailing catamaran to yourself! Enjoy the tranquility of sailing and the gorgeous Kona Sunset with your friends and family. Tropical juice, soft drinks, bottled water and individually packaged snacks are provided.

services.name: PRIVATE 3 Hr Charter
services.desc: Rates Private 3 Hr Charter: Starting at $1,395 for up to 8 guests. $109 for each additional guest. 23 guest maximum. About Have our beautiful sailing catamaran to yourself. Options include snorkeling, sailing, looking for wildlife or watching the sunset. The charter includes snacks, tropical fruit juice soft drinks and bottled water. Snorkeling gear is provided.
